sermon.title: God Using Nations to Judge Nations — October 18, 2020
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that God uses His people to judge ungodly nations, and other nations to correct His people when they sin. Judgment begins at the house of God. While the church slept, laws changed. Daniel foresaw a power warring against the saints, but the kingdom is given to the saints, and overcomers receive power over the nations.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

Therefore be patient, brethren, until the coming of the Lord. See how the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, waiting patiently for it until it receives the early and latter rain.

faqs.question: What happens when the righteous rule?
faqs.answer: When the righteous are in authority the people rejoice; when the wicked rule the people mourn. He that rules over men must be just.
